definitions.ask: Should Plex become reachable only over the tailnet and LAN, with internet exposure removed?
definitions.why: Internet-exposed 32400 was the entry point; all of Bryan's devices already use the tailnet

choices.label: Remote Access off, router mapping removed, 32400 firewalled; off-tailnet viewers lose access
Patched Remote Access stays on via one manual forward, UPnP off; the internet surface remains

definitions.ask: Should athena be cleaned in place instead of reinstalled?
definitions.why: Evidence shows only uid plex was held, and Step 2 must prove no root access before cleaning

choices.label: Keep OS, library and home; fall back to rebuild only if a root tripwire fires
Contain, preserve and report, then stop with a reinstall runbook; Plex stays off until rebuilt

definitions.ask: Should the existing Plex data directory be kept and scrubbed rather than replaced?
definitions.why: The payload sits in Codecs and /tmp; the database holds no code, and Step 2 sweeps for more

choices.label: Keep the database and watch history; quarantine code-bearing dirs and reset abused prefs
Quarantine all Plex data and start empty; re-claim server, re-add libraries, lose watch history

definitions.why: The plex account could read every world-readable home file; the next breach could too

choices.label: Home and ~/.config become 750 and secrets 600; other users that read ~bryan break until fixed
Home stays 755; only the identified secret files become 600

definitions.ask: Should the redacted incident report go in the bob-cli--research sidecar?
definitions.why: The sidecar holds durable reports, and redaction keeps tokens and malware out of git

choices.label: Redacted report (no binaries or tokens) in bob-cli--research; raw evidence stays on apollo
Report lives only beside the off-host evidence on apollo, outside any git repo
